title: A Logical Calculus of the Ideas Immanent in Nervous Activity
summary: Warren S. McCulloch and Walter Pitts published A Logical Calculus of the Ideas Immanent in Nervous Activity in The Bulletin of Mathematical Biophysics in December 1943, describing neural activity in terms of propositional logic and formal networks.
significance: A documented pre-1950 paper connecting formal logic with networks of simplified neural units, important to the early history of computational models of nervous activity.
